subject: Save user settings and calculation results and plots

messages.author: b6ae736a50fb2fe2
messages.subject: Save user settings and calculation results and plots
parts:
I have built a Shiny app that contains a flow of user settings and then calculations and output in order to produce an output.
How can I save the settings and output as kind of  a project so user will be able to open the project that was done in the past
and get all relevant settings and outputs?
For example, a user choose a k=5 for knn algorithm and produce a plot as an output.How can he go back to very same k=5 and plot output
without the need to run the code again.
